text:
Avery: Ok team — partners asked for a concrete phase-gate playbook for multi-region onramps (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi). I compiled a checklist. Feedback?

Noor: Love the gate idea. Please add a clear owner per gate; last time 'cert' slid because nobody owned kernel tagging.

Diego: Ops: callout on H200 microcode risk. Add a fast fallback path and a routing policy that prefers quantized variants when errors >5% in the probe window.

Priya: Comms: no single global press. We need embargo windows + region-specific bullets. Also include a short FAQ for SI partners on "what to expect" during preview.

Samir: SI/Integrators: we need sample images, one-click test harness (curl + smoke tests), and exact SKU naming. If you publish AMIs put kernel tags in the AMI name.

Avery: Draft playbook below. Keep it internal until legal signs off.

```
phase_gate_playbook_v1
Gate 0 - Pre-engage (owner: Partnerships)
  - Partner LOI, target regions, top-3 SKUs
  - Publish roadmap snapshot to partners
Gate 1 - Lab Cert (owner: Eng-ML)
  - Passing perf/regression on staging infra
  - Driver/firmware freeze candidate (tagged)
  - Kernel targets locked
Gate 2 - SI Preview (owner: Integrations)
  - Publish sample images + creds to s3://partners/preview/
  - Provide CI matrix and one-click harness
  - 7-10 day early access window
Gate 3 - Marketplace Preview (owner: Marketplace)
  - Limited SKU exposure in NA region
  - Traffic-shaping rules + burst pool config
  - Monitor: error rate, p99 latency, token cost delta
Gate 4 - Regional GA (owner: Partnerships/Marketplace)
  - EU GA then APAC GA (staggered weeks)
  - Press: regional embargo windows per comms
  - Enable full routing policies and quota scales
Fallbacks & Runbook
  - On H200 microcode anomaly -> route to `h200-quant` or `b200-small`
  - If error rate >5% for 10m -> auto-scale to reserved burst pools and throttle new sessions
  - Notify partners + SIs via daily status in #partnerships
SKU Naming
  - Standard: `redwood-<model>-<variant>-<region>` (e.g., `redwood-h100-standard-na`)
  - Tag marketplace PRs with `partners:region` label
Press & Embargo
  - NA T, EU T+7d, APAC T+14d
  - Comms to draft region-specific bullets and FAQ
```

Noor: Owners look good. For Gate 1 add a quick checklist for perf delta thresholds (p50/p95/p99) relative to baseline.

Diego: I'll implement the routing policy and fallback mapping by EOD Tue. Action item: `ops#routing` PR will reference this thread.

Priya: I'll draft embargo copy and the partner FAQ. Need finalized SKU names before EOD so FAQs match marketplace tiles.

Samir: Integrations will publish images and CI harness to s3 today. We'll follow the AMI naming guidance.

Avery: DeployBot, please post daily gate-status updates during the preview window (Gate2 -> Gate4).

DeployBot: Scheduled daily gate-status posts to #partnerships from 2024-11-01 to 2024-11-10.

Noor: One last ask: add a short rollback play in Gate 4 in case press uncovers a regression.

Avery: Good call — added rollback notes. If no more comments I'll lock and invite legal + comms for a 30m tomorrow. :+1:

Diego: Confirmed.

Priya: Confirmed.

Samir: Confirmed.
